channel.title: Open Source on 梦兽编程
channel.description: Recent content in Open Source on 梦兽编程

item.title: Some Things Just Take Time
item.description: Armin Ronacher on software development in the AI era: why a 50-year-old oak tree cannot be mass-produced, and why the things that truly matter all need time.

item.title: 4000 Pages Per Second: The Rust PDF Library That's Changing the Game
item.description: oxidize-pdf: A pure-Rust PDF engine with zero C dependencies, a 5MB binary, and performance that leaves Chromium and Java stacks in the dust.

item.title: Rust Multimedia: A 21-Year-Old Rewriting FFmpeg in Rust—Crazy or Genius?
item.description: A 21-year-old developer, Ajay Kumar, is rewriting FFmpeg from scratch in pure Rust. Why would anyone do this, and what does Rust change for multimedia work?

item.title: Manjaro 26.0 Is Here - Let's Talk About This Linux Distro
item.description: Manjaro 26.0 is officially released with KDE Plasma 6.5, Linux 6.18 kernel and more. Let's check out what's new in this beginner-friendly Arch-based distro.

item.title: open-coreui: Turning Open WebUI into a Rust food truck
item.description: open-coreui is a lite rewrite of Open WebUI v0.6.32: original frontend, rust/actix-web backend, single-binary deployment without Docker/Python/Postgres/Redis.

item.title: Pop!_OS 24.04 is Here: The World's First Rust-Built Desktop Environment
item.description: System76 releases Pop!_OS 24.04 and COSMIC desktop environment - the first production-grade desktop environment written entirely in Rust, challenging 20 years of GTK/Qt dominance. In-depth review: performance, customization, and tiling window management

item.title: European Governments Are Ditching Microsoft for Linux - What Do You Think of This Move?
item.description: Governments in Germany, Denmark, Spain and beyond are migrating from Windows to Linux at scale. This isn't a drill - it's really happening.

item.title: Mistral 3 Official Release: The Latest Work from Europe’s AI Giant
item.description: While OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic battle it out across the Atlantic, Europe’s AI power is quietly rising. On December 2, Paris-based Mistral AI officially released its third-generation model family, Mistral 3.

item.title: Snapdom: A New Engine for Web Screenshots, Say Goodbye to Lag
item.description: Snapdom gained 2000+ stars in two months - how does it use SVG magic to make web screenshots lightning fast? Say goodbye to html2canvas lag and experience the modern web screenshot solution
